# Improvestu / FARU

> FARU (Find A Ride University) is a campus carpool message board for verified college students. Chat first, meet on campus, ride with classmates. Not a taxi or rideshare dispatch service.

## Product
- Name: FARU
- URL: https://www.improvestu.com/faru/
- Company: Shot Call'a Games, LLC (Improvestu initiative)
- Contact: improvestu@gmail.com

## Pricing
- Free: campus browse, up to 5 open ride posts, Ride Requests, chat, SOS/guardians/check-ins, report/block
- FARU+: 30-day free trial, then $4.99/mo or $49.99/yr — wider campus browse, unlimited posts, Quick Rides, Class Rides, corridor alerts, For you, event rides, ad-free

## Downloads
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.faru.faru
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/faru-find-a-ride-university/id6801682857
